name: SFMOMA
daysHours: Mon–Tue 10am–5pm; Wed closed; Thu noon–8pm; Fri–Sun 10am–5pm
exceptions: Closed Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. Published special 2026 holiday hours include Dec 23 open 10am–5pm, Christmas Eve 10am–3pm, New Year’s Eve noon–5pm. Recheck official visit page before travel.
coupleCost: $60 standard adult admission for two (2 × $30); ticket/offer eligibility may change.

name: Alcatraz Island
location: San Francisco Bay; ferry access at Piers 31–33
exceptions: Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year’s Day; seasonal departures; reservations recommended and sellouts possible. Ticket/ferry schedule is controlled by Alcatraz City Cruises; confirm before booking.

name: Conservatory of Flowers
location: 100 John F. Kennedy Drive, Golden Gate Park, San Francisco
daysHours: Open six days a week, 10am–4:30pm; last entry 4pm
exceptions: Closed Wednesdays for weekly maintenance. Official site lists annual 2026 maintenance closure Jan 21–Feb 4; recheck current notices.

name: Japanese Tea Garden
location: 75 Hagiwara Tea Garden Drive, Golden Gate Park, San Francisco
daysHours: Daily from 9am; last entry varies by season (Mar–Oct 5:30pm; Nov–Feb 4:30pm)
exceptions: Last entry is 30 minutes before closing. Free hour Monday, Wednesday, Friday 9–10am. Verify seasonal updates before visiting.
